subject: Freelance email design support for Aware Digital
body:
Hi Aware Digital team,

I noticed that your Klaviyo services include branded template design alongside welcome, abandoned-cart and post-purchase automations. That mix is close to the work I do for e-commerce brands and email agencies.

I’m Shine, an email designer using this synthetic example profile with example experience. I turn supplied copy and brand assets into clear, mobile-friendly Figma layouts, and I can build approved designs in Klaviyo using editable, reusable blocks.

I’d be interested in supporting your team on campaign or flow-design projects when you need freelance help. My Figma design rate is USD 20–30 per email; Klaviyo building is quoted separately after reviewing the scope.

Here’s my portfolio:
https://portfolio.example.invalid/

Would you be open to considering me for freelance design support on a future project?

Best,
Shine

evidence.quote: Crafting branded email templates that are perfectly in sync with your brand and built for conversions
